prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
competitors_mentioned: Palm Beach Tan on Olentangy River Road
answer_verbatim:
If you mean **spray tanning**, **Sun Studio Tan** in the Short North is a strong pick: it’s at **612 N. High St.**, offers online booking, and its site highlights natural-looking results and walk-ins when a technician is available. [Sun Studio Tan](https://www.sunstudiotan.com/)

For **UV tanning beds**, **Palm Beach Tan on Olentangy River Road** is another well-reviewed option; its listing shows **4.57/5 from 176 reviews**. [Location details](https://palmbeachtan.com/locations/oh/columbus-olentangy-river-road)

“Best” depends on whether you want a spray tan or UV tanning. Keep in mind that UV tanning increases skin-cancer and skin-aging risk; sunless spray tanning avoids UV exposure.
